name: Action / Platformer
description: Tight movement and combat through hand-built levels. Game feel is its own pillar because it makes or breaks the genre.

pillars.name: Movement
pillars.vision: How the player runs, jumps and traverses; the verb everything else is built around.

pillars.name: Run and Jump
pillars.vision: Ground speed, acceleration, jump arcs, coyote time and input buffering.

pillars.name: Dash
pillars.vision: Burst movement: distance, cooldown and how it chains with other moves.

pillars.name: Wall Interactions
pillars.vision: Wall slides, wall jumps, ledge grabs and climbing.

pillars.name: Combat
pillars.vision: How the player fights: attacks, hits and damage.

pillars.name: Attacks
pillars.vision: The player's attacks, combos and their timing windows.

pillars.name: Hit Reactions
pillars.vision: Knockback, hitstun, invulnerability frames and feedback on both sides of a hit.

pillars.name: Damage
pillars.vision: Health, damage values and how the player dies and respawns.

pillars.name: Camera
pillars.vision: How the camera follows, frames and leads the action.

pillars.name: Level Design
pillars.vision: Hand-built levels that teach, test and reward the player's moves.

pillars.name: Checkpoints
pillars.vision: Where the player respawns and how much progress a death costs.

pillars.name: Hazards
pillars.vision: Spikes, pits, moving platforms and other environmental dangers.

pillars.name: Secrets
pillars.vision: Hidden areas and collectibles that reward mastery and exploration.

pillars.name: Enemies
pillars.vision: What the player fights, and how each one tests a different skill.

pillars.name: Enemy Archetypes
pillars.vision: The regular enemies: behaviors, attack patterns and placement rules.

pillars.name: Bosses
pillars.vision: Multi-phase encounters that test everything the player has learned.

pillars.name: Game Feel
pillars.vision: The juice that makes actions feel good: animation, VFX, screen shake and audio cues.

pillars.name: Animation
pillars.vision: Character animation and how it reads and supports responsiveness.

pillars.name: VFX
pillars.vision: Particles and effects for hits, movement and the world.

pillars.name: Audio Cues
pillars.vision: Sound effects that confirm actions and telegraph threats.

pillars.name: UI
pillars.vision: Menus, HUD and how the game communicates with the player.
